execution: Read-only extraction; saved cost summation only; no new score/model/protection/sample.

metric_definitions.recall5: For each purpose/category with nonempty true top-5 reference R, |answer intersection R| / |R|. The local answer comes only from received candidates. k=5 is an upper bound; |R| can be less than5.
metric_definitions.aggregation: Mean valid categories within event, then defined event windows within family/draw/purpose, then draws within family; equal family and equal purpose weighting. Reference coverage is identical across draws. Fresh primary uses 24 family clusters, not 18,114 independent ticks or 72 independent draws.
metric_definitions.empty_reference: N/A retained with all-event/category denominators, not awarded100%. Defined truth reference but no valid answer scores0.
metric_definitions.uncertainty: Fresh mean-difference 95% interval: saved paired whole-family percentile bootstrap, 10,000 resamples, statistical seed 2026100617; all eight sessions and three draws stay inside family. Only current/all/four-purpose macro is confirmatory; purpose/cold/tail/cache intervals are exploratory.
metric_definitions.hit100: Fraction of attacker point estimates within100 metres of scenario truth.
metric_definitions.point_EIE: Same point-decoder error mean as MAE when metric, target and aggregation match; not separate privacy evidence.
metric_definitions.position_error: Sensor Euclidean pre/post public-road snap error, pooled18114 events; not family-weighted Recall or GPS calibration.
metric_definitions.balanced_accuracy: (sensitivity+specificity)/2; binarychance.5. Ordinaryaccuracy may be inflated by pair imbalance.
metric_definitions.ROC_AUC: Score discrimination. AUC below.5 is not blanketprivacy; score inversion/calibration and strongper-familyAUC remain relevant.
metric_definitions.paper_v2_aggregation: Equal means over12completedrecord×drawcells, each internally averaging relevant events;12isnotanindependentGPSpointdenominator.
metric_definitions.paper_v2_cost: Saved payload_json_bytes_per_request contains serialized publicevents/categories PLUS simulatedPOIresponses, dividedbyinputevents; notrequest-only.
metric_definitions.latency: No measured end-to-end latency. Publicationdelay0 meansnodetentionalholding, notzeronetworklatency.

dynamic_status_sensitivity.provider_contract: Top-L STATIC nearest records per public category + CURRENT epoch availability bit; no available-first filtering; all-purpose fixed requests
dynamic_status_sensitivity.cache_rule: StaticIDs can persist; bits expire at absolute60s epoch, unknown != unavailable. Answers need known CURRENT available status; no secret-purpose retry.
dynamic_status_sensitivity.bulk_scope: Current full-catalogue bulk achieves100% with no location upload and lower JSONcost. StrongerAPI than topL, valid control if application permits.
dynamic_status_sensitivity.unsafe_scope: Stale unsafe arm is deliberately invalid; unavailable/unknown item counts overlap, never combine or call live quality.
dynamic_status_sensitivity.validation_caveat: Pre-score checker failure retained. V2 post-score serialization-order correction uses uniqueevent/arm keys; runner/fixture/scores unchanged.

Public research fixture lets informed client compute statuses; experimentalAPI excludes it by assumption only.
